reason: The selected live slice crosses dogmove.c target selection, a narrow mhitm.c attack projection, and retry-planning state isolation. The target scoring, distant physical miss, and live dog_move() consumer are not implemented yet.

boundary.startingEvent: A completed hero command gives an awake, sighted, unconfused ordinary starting kitten, little dog, or pony a dog_move() action while an ordinary visible monster is aligned two to seven squares away.
boundary.endingEvent: pet_ranged_attk(FALSE) has selected and scored the target, mattackm() has taken only the distant physical-attack miss path, the pet has completed its remaining movement and postmov() work, and the game is waiting for the next hero input.
boundary.validInputs: Ordinary starting kitten, little dog, or pony; active edog pet; visible ordinary nonadjacent target on one of the eight rays within distance 7; selected, rejected-negative-score, and no-target outcomes; dog and kitten bite arrays and pony kick-plus-bite array; ordinary and hungry pet gates when reachable before the ending event.
boundary.observables: Exact RNG calls and order; target choice; pet and defender coordinates, movement, wake state, mlstmv, visibility and combat scratch state; messages, screens, cursor, attributes, and persisted storage through the next prompt; atomic retry behavior if a later planned action refuses.
boundary.exclusions: Confused, blind, minion, priest, guardian, vampshifter, or non-starting pets; adjacent melee, displacement, retaliation, hero attacks, and real AT_WEAP, AT_BREA, AT_SPIT, gaze, spell, or other ranged attacks. Every reachable excluded path must refuse before changing state, consuming RNG, or writing output.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: Trace dogmove.c dog_move() from its pet_ranged_attk(FALSE) checkpoint through pet_ranged_attk(), best_target(), score_targ(), find_targ(), and find_friends(), then trace the selected ordinary target through mhitm.c mattackm() and mhitu.c getmattk().
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: Read the mons[] attack arrays and ordinary starting-pet selection for PM_KITTEN, PM_LITTLE_DOG, and PM_PONY; account for edog hunger state, monster alignment, msound, attack type, tame/peaceful state, and the eight ray directions in C loop order.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: Follow every call and short-circuit reachable from the fixed species and target family through the next prompt, including find_friends() line scanning, score_targ() fuzz, hungry gating, mattackm() setup, dog_move() continuation, and postmov().
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Search js/dogmove.js, js/mhitm.js, js/unported_monster_actions.js, and the monster-action tests for injected seams, UnsupportedSimpleMonsterActionError reasons, partial source ports, state cloning, and shared gb/gn/gv/gs scratch objects.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: Fresh recordings must prove a natural aligned target and every live state/RNG effect. Source tracing must still show whether hungrytime is reachable in the five development stretches and whether any fixed-species getmattk() substitution or attack-slot side effect survives the stated exclusions.
